claims.quote: "The Council wants one thing," he said. "A single spindle."
claims.value: require Amina to steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah

claims.quote: "The Spindle," I repeated, because names were the handles you used on troubles. "From Isle Jarrah."
"Our reasons are not for your keeping," he said. "They are urgent. You must understand urgency without understanding why."
When I thought about prying it loose, a quick, hot thing stabbed under my ribs as if someone had found the seam of me and slackened it.
claims.value: causes sharp pain when resisting and enforces compliance

claims.quote: "It is binding," he said. "It enforces compliance. Resistance is costly."

"Not none. Not absolute. The instrument we affix is a law, not a god. It can be resisted by a strong mortal will, it can be countered by the witches' craft, and it can be made irrelevant by what you seek—the Spindle—if used under the island's terms."
claims.value: can be resisted by strong will, countered by witches' craft, or made irrelevant by using the Spindle under island's terms

claims.quote: "You want me to go," I said. Saying it made the word solid. "You want the Spindle from Isle Jarrah. You have bound me to that task. I will go."
claims.value: accepted mission to steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah aboard the Qitaf

claims.quote: The map looked like someone else's dying hope, a thing neither dead nor alive. Azraq folded the folio back into itself and let it go.
claims.value: folio map and wreck log fragment remain aboard the Qitaf

claims.quote: "But I go to keep my crew. I keep my command. Your enforcement stays on my throat, but your hands stay out of my ship while she is mine."
claims.value: intends to keep command of the Qitaf and crew while undertaking the mission

promises.promise: Azraq's departure and Amina's insistence that the Peri Council's agents will not interfere with her crew while she retains command is a conditional promise; the Council must keep its hands off the Qitaf while she is in command.
promises.quote: "But I go to keep my crew. I keep my command. Your enforcement stays on my throat, but your hands stay out of my ship while she is mine."
